description: Enterprise techniques used by MiniBike, ATT&CK software S9059 (v1.0)
name: MiniBike (S9059)

techniques.comment: [MiniBike](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9059) has leveraged HTTP calls to the C2.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Feb2024)

[MiniBike](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9059) has established persistence through the creation of registry keys to include `HKCU\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run\OneDriveFileCoAuth.exe`.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Feb2024)
[MiniBike](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9059) has collected files from the local victim machines.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Feb2024)
[MiniBike](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9059) has uploaded files over the C2.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Feb2024)
[MiniBike](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9059) has enumerated directories and files on victim machines.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Feb2024)
[MiniBike](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9059) has been deployed using a launcher, which has been executed via search-order-hijacking (SoH).(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Feb2024)
[MiniBike](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9059) has the ability to download files from the C2.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Feb2024)
[MiniBike](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9059) has been delivered within an archive, such as a ZIP file, delivered via spearphishing.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Feb2024)
[MiniBike](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9059) has collected system information from the victim machine.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Feb2024)
